5. **Charlotte** – Mike and Emma's daughter (born around the same time as Max, ~March)

- **Rocky** is your neighbor's adopted dog, so his "gotcha day" doesn't count either.

So: 5 babies born in the last few months, plus 1 adopted child (Aaliyah) if you're tracking new additions to the family more broadly.
